about.description: The public catalog of provisioner packages for hyperweaver-agent and zoneweaver-agent, with per-organization private catalogs behind STARTcloud sign-in.
about.goal: One place to find, trust and deploy every provisioner an organization publishes.

features.catalogs: Public catalog plus private catalogs per organization
features.tiers: Quality tiers measured on every data run
features.watches: Watch provisioners and get notified of releases
features.deploy: Deploy a provisioner straight into Hyperweaver

data.title: Data job
data.releases: Publishes catalog.json from each repository's GitHub releases
data.validation: Validation action authors run in their own CI
data.tiers: Measures quality tiers and health every run

web.title: Web UI
web.pages: React app served from GitHub Pages
web.signIn: STARTcloud sign-in with PKCE and DPoP
web.shared: Navbar and pages shared byte for byte with BoxVault

worker.title: Worker
worker.gate: Gates private catalogs behind the organization's token

docs.intro: Learn how the catalog is built, how to publish a provisioner and how to consume it.

support.intro: The catalog is open source; issues and contributions are welcome.

search.placeholder: Search provisioners by name, description, or repository…

card.tierTooltip: Measured quality tier — recomputed every data run

description.label: Description
description.requirement: Add a non-empty description to provisioner.yml.

label.label: Display label
label.requirement: Add a non-empty label to provisioner.yml; name stays the slug.

semver_versions.label: Semantic versions
semver_versions.requirement: Name every versioned asset name-major.minor.patch.tar.gz and drop releases whose version is not semver-shaped.

latest_alias.label: Latest alias
latest_alias.requirement: Upload name.tar.gz beside the versioned archive on each release.

changelog.label: Changelog shipped
changelog.requirement: Ship CHANGELOG.md at the package root so it lands in the archive.

readme.label: README shipped
readme.requirement: Ship README.md at the package root so it lands in the archive.

release_within_12_months.label: Released within a year
release_within_12_months.requirement: Publish a release; the newest one is older than 365 days.

lint_ci.label: Lint in CI
lint_ci.requirement: Add an ansible/ansible-lint step to a workflow under .github/workflows.

config_fields_documented.label: Configuration fields documented
config_fields_documented.requirement: Give every configuration field a label and a tooltip, and declare at least one.

roles_documented.label: Roles documented
roles_documented.requirement: Give every role a label and a description, and declare at least one.

example_hosts.label: Example Hosts file
example_hosts.requirement: Ship Hosts.example.yml at the package root, or examples/Hosts.yml.

automated_tests.label: Automated tests
automated_tests.requirement: Ship molecule scenarios for at least half of the declared roles and run them green in CI as Molecule jobs before cutting the release.

multi_provider.label: Verified images for two providers
multi_provider.requirement: Make Hosts.template.yml render for at least two listed providers, each naming an image the box catalog serves.

release_cadence.label: Release cadence
release_cadence.requirement: Publish at least two releases in a rolling year, at least 30 days apart.

booted_providers.label: Booted on every verified provider
booted_providers.requirement: Add a CI job per verified provider that boots a machine from the rendered Hosts.yml and reports a green Boot check run on the release commit.

errors.accessDenied: Access denied by the catalog gate.
